The user wants to mark compilation errors from the bottom console with a red line in the left margin of the editor at the exact line where the error is.

T1 found the mechanism for marking errors in the editor margin: `Make Editor Panel` calls `diagnostics for editor line` in a loop. If `show diagnostic suffix line` is true, it assigns a `gutter marker` and `suffix ptr` rendered in the gutter. Severity is translated via `diagnostic severity tr`.
T2 looked for reading errors from the console to create diagnostics. It found `diagnostics for editor line`, `diagnostics on line`, `terminal selected text`, `select console word at`, `scan shell output for linker errors`.
T3 looked for extracting errors from console text to create diagnostics. It found `scan shell output for linker errors`.

The pack shows:

T1 => T3: sin camino
T2 => T3: same object `scan shell output for linker errors`
